rows.prompt: A seamless square terrain texture seen straight down from above: the floor of a low, wet-black forest in permanent dusk, over ground that breathes metal-rich gas. Poison soil: damp wet-black and slate-grey earth, stained in faint pale mineral rings where gas has seeped up, scattered with tiny pinhole vents and beads of glassy condensate, thin streaks of grey metallic crust. Fine, even grain.
rows.biome_register: permanent dusk: flat, directionless scatter light, cool and dim, no warm light anywhere
rows.style_notes: Ground texture for a RimWorld floor, seen straight down from above: fully opaque, tiles seamlessly in both directions, no vignette, no edge darkening, no single dominant feature, even flat sourceless light with no cast shadows; muted, matte, painterly vanilla-RimWorld house style; low value overall so a colonist sprite reads clearly on top.
rows.owner_note: Dark, gassy soil: wet-black and slate ground that visibly breathes metal-rich gas.
rows.oversize_reason: tiling terrain texture: one 1024 tile repeats across many cells, matching vanilla Terrain/Surfaces and our other custom terrains (1024x1024 RGB)
